parole.significato: circle dance, dance in which the participants form a circle, walk or dance rhythmically and sing or chant
parole.testo: From Middle Dutch rei, from Picard rey, from Old French raie, roie. Cognate to German Reigen, English ray.

16th century, from Picard take, from Old Northern French tasque, variant of Old French tasche, from Vulgar Latin tasca, from older taxa, deverbal from Latin taxare. Cognate with English task, French tâche.
